The field guide

A little context.
A lot more clarity.

SuperTuriya is an early reliability and governance control plane for stateful, tool-using agents. It connects failure evidence, a bounded repair, replay verification, and human decisions in one inspectable workflow.

The principle: a model can propose a repair. Evidence and explicit checks determine whether the test passed. A human decides whether a verified lesson becomes reusable policy.

Explore the playground

Choose one of 12 synthetic resource-provisioning failures. Investigate the trace, inspect the proposed change, approve a replay, and review the checks. You can activate a verified lesson in the tab's simulated workspace, revoke it, export the evidence, or start again.

The hosted playground uses recorded results exported from the Python engine. It does not invoke a language model, execute real tools, write to an operator database, or deploy a policy. Its session state is kept in browser memory and clears when the page reloads.

  • Wrong quantity: a negative tool argument is corrected to the requested positive quantity.
  • Stale memory: old regional preference conflicts with current intent.
  • Missing approval: an explicit approval check is restored.
  • Two things went wrong: correcting order leaves evidence unresolved. Activation stays blocked.

Open the interactive playground

Run the reference implementation

The local runtime uses Python 3.9+ and SQLite, with no mandatory API key or external dependency for frozen mode.

git clone --branch launch/cosmic-workbench-2026-11-21 https://github.com/Anirvium/SuperTuriya.git
cd SuperTuriya
python3 -m superturiya --seed --port 8765

Open http://127.0.0.1:8765. This release branch includes the operator workbench: approval runs the Python replay and activation persists an audited policy. The main branch remains a separate historical snapshot.

Protected operator sessions

Configure a bearer token with a fixed tenant and principal before exposing an operator server beyond loopback. The workbench accepts the token for the current tab only; it is not stored in local storage. An authenticated principal is the reviewer identity. Use a secure HTTPS reverse proxy for a private deployment.

export SUPERTURIYA_API_TOKEN='your-secret'
export SUPERTURIYA_API_TENANT='your-team'
export SUPERTURIYA_API_PRINCIPAL='your-operator'
python3 -m superturiya --seed --port 8765

Never place API tokens in a public website or URL. The public playground is intentionally independent of the operator API.

Reproduce the frozen evidence

python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
make validate
make evaluate
make v2-verify
make v2-sut-verify

Read the results in context

The controlled frozen benchmark has 12 held-out synthetic failures across six classes. It reproduces 3/12 baseline recoveries and 11/12 SuperTuriya recoveries. These fixtures and development rules do not establish generalization.

External-v2 contains 16 AI-authored blinded/adversarial cases over four cloud-operations scenario families using the same simulator. Across three trials, both systems recovered 8/16. Critical-step localization was 100%, decisive-invariant accuracy 81.25%, and mean repair-surface accuracy 41.67%. These are properties of that experiment, with its small sample and stated limits.

The newer replay-guided selector is a separate layer. Historical frozen artifacts remain unchanged. Candidate comparison on the old examples is a demonstration of mechanics, not a new independent benchmark result.

AgentRx is credited for trajectory representation, invariant-based inspection and localization. DoVer is credited for targeted intervention, re-execution and recovery measurement. SuperTuriya combines these ideas with explicit governance and evidence-based policy promotion.

Privacy, plainly

This website does not add analytics scripts, advertising pixels, third-party fonts, or customer-log uploads. The playground fetches synthetic examples and keeps your interaction state in the current tab. Evidence downloads are generated in your browser.

The hosting provider may process ordinary request and security logs under its own policies. External links take you to GitHub. The conversation form opens a draft GitHub issue for you to review; submitting it makes that content public. Do not include credentials, private traces, or customer information.

The local operator workspace stores traces, policies, and audit records in the SQLite database you configure. Its retention and deletion facilities do not establish hosted enterprise deletion or backup guarantees.

What comes next

The next product milestone is a narrow real-agent integration: import a trace, reproduce the failure, test a bounded change, and verify a measurable benefit in shadow mode. That needs faithful snapshots, explicitly modeled side effects, authorization review, and new evaluation data.

We welcome design partners with a concrete workflow and a willingness to inspect the evidence together.
